messages:
Maya (Support): Heads up — pilot tenant OmniShop is hitting intermittent 502s on bulk ingest since yesterday evening. Ticket OS-7780.
AlertBot: OS-7780 escalated to P1 and routed to #customer-success.
Hector (CSM): Renewal call in 2 weeks. If feed is unstable we need a tight comms plan and mitigation ASAP.
Priya (CS Ops): Can you share error snippets + whether it's backfill vs real-time? I can draft customer note and a quick runbook.
Maya (Support): Two patterns: POST /v1/ingest -> upstream 502 during large batches; and occasional `422` parsing error for `order.items` when items array is empty. Logs attached.
Tom (SE): Likely cause: bulk worker times out under big batch and parser expects non-empty items array. Short-term: ask them to split large files into 500-row chunks and disable aggressive retry. Long-term: we can make parser accept empty arrays and add chunked processing.
Hector (CSM): I'll tell the customer the workaround while Tom prepares a hotfix. Communicate: pause full backfill, run incremental chunks, we will provide a hotfix within 24h.
Priya (CS Ops): COMM TEMPLATE: "Hi <Name>, we detected intermittent ingestion failures during large backfills. Short-term: please split large files into smaller chunks (<=500 rows) and pause concurrent backfills. Our engineers are deploying a tolerant parser within 24 hours. We'll update by EOD." 
Tom (SE): Starting canary patch now. If canary passes I'll schedule prod rollout with 10m monitoring.
Maya (Support): Customer replied — they can chunk files starting now and will provide a sample. Marking handoff to CS after canary success.
Hector (CSM): I'll send exec note and schedule an enablement walkthrough after the fix so their ops avoid backfill patterns that trigger this. Also logging product feedback: better preflight tests and backfill safety docs.
Priya (CS Ops): Tasks: ack+workaround -> Hector (15m); run sample+canary -> Tom (3h); prod rollout -> SE/Support (24h); postmortem+renewal note -> Priya/Hector (48h).
Maya (Support): Updated OS-7780 and will reassign to Hector when canary is green. :thumbsup:
